findings.title: Inconsistent lightness value introduced in dark-light-choose conversion
findings.body: The original rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%);`. The conversion should preserve the light-theme value as the first argument (30%) with secondary at 70%, consistent with every other conversion in this PR (e.g. `scale-color($primary, 50%), scale-color($secondary, 50%)` pairs sum to 100). Instead this line was converted to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`, which uses 70%/30% instead of 30%/70%. This changes the rendered color in light themes (much lighter/washed out) compared to the pre-PR behavior, unlike all the other mechanically-correct conversions in this diff.

findings.title: Lightness value changed instead of preserved during dark-light-choose conversion
findings.body: Original: `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%);`. Correct conversion per the pattern used elsewhere would be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`. Instead it was converted to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, silently changing the light-theme color from a 20%-lightened primary to a 50%-lightened primary. This is a visual regression for light themes on the topic-map heading in mobile.

findings.title: Lightness value changed instead of preserved during dark-light-choose conversion
findings.body: Original: `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%);`. It should have become `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))` to preserve the original light-theme rendering, matching the pattern used in `desktop/user.scss` for the same `.group-member-info .name` selector (which correctly used 30%/70%). Here it was instead converted to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, which changes the light-theme color and is inconsistent with the equivalent desktop stylesheet.

findings.title: Lightness value changed instead of preserved during dark-light-choose conversion
findings.body: Original: `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%);`. The desktop equivalent (`desktop/modal.scss`) correctly converts the same style to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Here, however, it was converted to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, inverting the light/dark values and changing the rendered light-theme color for `.custom-message-length` on mobile, inconsistent with the desktop version of the same component.
